question: Against which of the following Acts did Mahatma Gandhi decide to launch nationwide Satyagraha in 1919?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rowlatt Act.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** decided to launch nationwide** Satyagraha** against the **Rowlatt Act, **which was passed by the **British government in 1919.**
 
• The Rowlatt Act allowed the British government to** imprison any person without trial, **and it was seen as a **direct attack** on the civil liberties of the Indian people.
 
• The Satyagraha movement led by Mahatma Gandhi against the Rowlatt Act was one of the first **mass movements against British rule** in India, and it played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Regulating Act of 1773** was the first major British law on the governance of India.

 
 
• It was an Act of the British Parliament designed to r**estructure the East India Company's administration **of its dominion over India. 
 
 
 
• The** Inland Emigration Act of 1859** regulated the movement of Indian laborers.
 
 
• It made it **illegal for Assamese plantation** laborers to **leave the tea estate **without authorization.
 
 
 
• The **Pitt's India Act of 1784** reformed the East India Company's governance of India.
 
 
• In order to** address the shortcomings** of the **Regulating Act of 1773**, it was passed by the British Parliament.
